title: Drift-Aware Multimodal User Representation Learning via Multi-Scale Temporal Modeling and Sparse Mixture-of-Experts
abstract: arXiv:2608.25773v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Understanding user preferences from noisy and temporally evolving social media behaviors is fundamentally challenging due to interest drift, where user preferences shift across time and exhibit both multi-scale temporal patterns and diverse co-existing interests. To address this, we propose DUMoE, a unified framework for drift-aware multimodal user representation learning. Our model consists of (i) a temporal dynamics-aware backbone that captures and integrates static profiles, short-term behavioral signals, and long-term dependencies into a coherent representation, and (ii) a sparse mixture-of-experts (MoE) interest adapter that disentangles multiple latent interests via expert specialization and adaptive routing. Each expert models a distinct interest subspace, while a gating network dynamically selects and aggregates a sparse subset of relevant experts for each user. translated_title: 基于多尺度时间建模与稀疏专家混合的漂移感知多模态用户表示学习
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.25773v1 公告类型：新 摘要：从嘈杂且随时间演变的社交媒体行为中理解用户偏好，本质上具有挑战性，因为存在兴趣漂移，即用户偏好随时间变化，并表现出多尺度时间模式和多样化的共存兴趣。为解决这一问题，我们提出了DUMoE，一个用于漂移感知多模态用户表示学习的统一框架。我们的模型包括：(i) 一个时间动态感知主干，捕获并整合静态画像、短期行为信号和长期依赖，形成连贯表示；(ii) 一个稀疏专家混合（MoE）兴趣适配器，通过专家专业化和自适应路由来解耦多个潜在兴趣。每个专家建模一个独特的兴趣子空间，而门控网络动态选择并为每个用户聚合稀疏的相关专家子集。为实现稳定有效的优化，我们进一步引入了一种...
tldr: 本文提出DUMoE框架，通过多尺度时间建模和稀疏专家混合技术，有效捕获用户兴趣漂移并解耦多模态偏好，解决了社交媒体行为中兴趣随时间演变的表示学习难题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the DUMoE framework, which leverages multi-scale temporal modeling and sparse mixture-of-experts to capture user interest drift and disentangle multimodal preferences, addressing the challenge of learning representations from temporally evolving social media behaviors.
